+.reason: The Equals key sends the same Windows key code; modifiers choose its shifted symbol.

ALT.reason: Left/right Alt choices expose modifier output. Preserve the generic imported token rather than rewriting it.

CONTROL.reason: Left/right Control choices expose modifier output; preserve generic imported spelling.

SHIFT.reason: Left/right Shift choices expose modifier output; preserve generic imported spelling.

SUBSTRACT.reason: Typo alias of the graphical numpad Subtract output; valid imported syntax remains accepted.

NONE.reason: Remove command and empty-binding controls write NONE; empty menu items do not show a fake None command.

SMALL_RUMBLE.reason: Graphical feedback controls encode strong/weak motor amplitudes instead of this raw shortcut.

BIG_RUMBLE.reason: Graphical feedback controls encode strong/weak motor amplitudes instead of this raw shortcut.

RFF80.reason: Representative parameterized rumble output; typed motor amplitude controls own this family.

HAPTIC_BOTH_CLICK_0.reason: Representative parameterized haptic output; side, effect and gain use the graphical haptic editor.
